issues.detail: Pane tunnel lining still nearly as light as the bezel (carried over from w5a)
issues.problem: The grey tunnel lining is the strongest cue that the opening is deep. In the render it is a pale ring only 0.86 of the bezel, so the glass looks set nearly flush in the bowl (q12, ra_jWin, win_close). The photos also show a dark shade-channel gap line between the bezel and the lining. The model has no such line.
issues.evidence: tt_window.jpg (full-res px): lining #6e6758 L104 at (1620-1660,1250-1700) vs bezel #c2b395 L180 at (1760-1860,1250-1700) = 0.58. Render ra_jWin: lining #c3c3c1 L195 at (700-710,380-430) vs bezel L227 at (675-690,380-430) = 0.86. q12: the lining reads as a light grey ring, with only the thin blue seal line darker.
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.123: WMAT.lining '#aba69d' -> '#8a857c'. In windowParts l.318 (lining loft), add a shade fn as the 3rd tuple entry that grades by depth, e.g. (y)=>0.85 (or a per-ring colour 1.0 at the 0.992 ring to 0.75 at the pane ring), so the inner end reads darker. Add a 3 mm dark channel ring between the rolled opening and the lining: a ringLoft [[scl(open,0.992),D+0.026],[scl(open,0.986),D+0.030]] in WMAT.seal. Target in-cabin lining/bezel 0.60-0.70.

issues.detail: Upper-tub shading now points the right way but is too shallow
issues.problem: The w6 grade correctly puts the darkest tone just above the opening (fixing w5b's inversion). On screen, though, it bottoms out at only 0.90-0.93 of the wall, so the bowls still read white on white from aisle distance (s01, s09, q16). The real upper tub just above the bezel is clearly grey.
issues.evidence: Column profiles: w6 s02 x710: tub 203 at the top, 192 above the bezel, wall 213 (0.90). s09 x610: 201 vs 216 (0.93). s01 x500: 201 vs 216 (0.93). sp_py14 x560: 186 near the top, 127-136 above the bezel, pier x470 ~175 (0.72-0.78). tt_window: 99-101 above the opening vs pier 153 (0.65), 131 near the top (0.86). y_47303 x393: 129-140 above the pane vs tub 185-204 (0.68).
issues.fix: l.314 tubShade: minimum 0.60 -> 0.42 in both lerps, and start the down-grade lower (d - 0.04 instead of d - 0.08). The reveal glow (04_shaders) lifts it by ~1.5x, which should land ~0.75 on screen. If the glow still flattens it, ask lighting to mask the glow on faces whose normal points down (ny < -0.2).

issues.detail: Door cross-aisle floor between the galley blocks is brown carpet; the photos show grey mottled vinyl
issues.problem: floor zones of type 'door' all use MAT.doorCarpet (l.561), so the whole walkway between the galley blocks at door 2 renders dark warm brown (s06, s07, ra_door2floor). The real door-2 walkway between the galley carts is grey stone-look vinyl. Only the bay right at the door, outboard of the galley ends, is a darker brown.
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.556-562: split each door zone's floor box in x. Use MAT.vinyl for |x| < ~1.9 m (out to the outboard ends of the galley/closet blocks), and MAT.doorCarpet only for the outboard ~0.9 m bays by each door. Also make doorCarpet less red: '#5c4f49' -> '#57504a' (target h~30, s~0.10).

issues.detail: Door viewing window collides with the red arming-arc arrowhead (shell/monuments conflict)
issues.problem: The shell puts the glazed slot at c+0.28 m (0.18-0.38 aft), 0.75-1.21 m high. The monuments' red arc spans c +/- 0.25 at 1.12-1.27 m, with its arrowhead box at c+0.25, 1.10 m, so the red block sits on the window glass in every door view. No real door shows a red marking over the viewing window.
issues.evidence: s06/s07 (w6 and w5c): red arrowhead over the upper half of the glass at (493-517, 315-340). The sp_py53 exterior shows the viewing window as a clear tall slot about 0.22 x 0.40 m (frame incl.), clear of any marking, roughly mid-leaf (0.41 of the leaf width from the hinge edge; perspective, low confidence).
issues.fix: Coordinate with monuments (10_mono.js l.757-761): shorten the arc to c-0.25..c+0.12 (arrowhead at c+0.12), or raise it above 1.25 m. Shell side: keep wz = c+0.28 until an inside photo confirms it; then possibly move it toward c+0.10 (sp_py53). Also add a soft 6 mm seam ring round the door window reveal (l.622) so it reads as a moulded frame, not a hole in the slab.

issues.detail: Grille ribs still read as light vertical bars

issues.fix: l.129 WMAT.rib '#4a4e56' -> '#3a3e46' and l.356 offset 0.0045 -> 0.0030 (behind the slat front edge 0.0055) so the ribs fall into shadow.
